Lecture Overview:
Should you optimize your AI agent's prompts or fine-tune its weights? In this Stanford CS329Z: Engineering AI Agents lecture, Michael Ryan, whose prompt-optimization algorithms are used across industry, covers when optimization pays off, context optimization (bootstrapped few-shot, OPRO, MIPROv2, TextGrad, GEPA), weight optimization (SFT on agent rollouts, PPO vs. GRPO, on-policy distillation), agents as optimizers (Darwin Gödel Machine, autoresearch), and a practical guide to choosing between prompts and weights.
Speaker: Michael Ryan
